summary: 机器人能以较低成本承担太空探测，人类则擅长应对意外并作出现场判断。作者主张两者协作，以火星前哨方案说明缩短遥控距离的价值，并讨论人类亲自探索太空的意义。
logic: 比较载人与无人探测的成本
人类探索与地球的意义

paragraphs.brief: 让人类参与太空探索所遇到的问题。
sentences: The advisability of humans participating directly in space travel continues to cause many debates.
人类直接参与空间旅行的可取性继续引起许多辩论。

There is no doubt that the presence of people on board a space vehicle makes its design much more complex and challenging, and produces a large increase in costs, since safety requirements are greatly increased, and the performance of the technology providing necessities for human passengers such as oxygen, food and water must be guaranteed.
毫无疑问，航天器上人员的存在使其设计更加复杂和更具挑战性，并造成费用大幅增加，因为安全要求大大增加，必须为人类乘客提供氧气、食物和水等必需品的技术的性能必须得到保证。
Moreover, the systems required are bulky and costly, and their complexity increases for long-duration missions.
此外，所需的系统庞大，费用高昂，而且对长期特派团来说，其复杂性也有所增加。
Meanwhile, advances in electronics and computer science allow increasingly complex tasks to be entrusted to robots, and unmanned space probes are becoming lighter, smaller and more convenient.
同时，电子和计算机科学的进步使机器人承担了越来越复杂的任务，无人空间探测器变得越来越轻、较小和方便。

paragraphs.brief: 机器人在太空中的若干局限。
sentences: However, experience has shown that the idea of humans in space is popular with the public.
然而，经验表明，在太空中人的思想受到公众的欢迎。
Humans can also be useful; there are many cases when only direct intervention by an astronaut or cosmonaut can correct the malfunction of an automatic device.
人类也可能有用；在很多情况下，只有宇航员或宇航员的直接干预才能纠正自动装置的故障。

Astronauts and cosmonauts have proved that they can adapt to conditions of weightlessness and work in space without encountering too many problems, as was seen in the operations to repair and to upgrade the Hubble Space Telescope.
宇航员和宇航员已经证明，他们能够适应失重和在空间工作的条件，而不会遇到太多问题，正如哈勃空间望远镜的修理和升级操作所显示的那样。
One human characteristic which is particularly precious in space missions, and which so far is lacking in robots, is the ability to perform a great variety of tasks.
在空间飞行任务中特别宝贵的一个人类特征是有能力执行各种任务，而迄今为止机器人缺乏这种特性。
In addition, robots are not good at reacting to situations they have not been specifically prepared for.
此外，机器人不善于应对他们没有具体准备的情况。
This is especially important in the case of deep space missions.
这对于深空飞行任务尤其重要。

While in the case of the Moon it is possible for someone on Earth to ‘tele-operate’ a robotic device such as a probe, as the two-way link time is only a couple of seconds, on Mars the two-way link time is several minutes, so sending instructions from Earth is more difficult.
在月球方面，地球上的人可以“远程操作”一个机器人装置，如探测器，因为双向连接时间只有几秒钟，在火星上，双向连接的时间是几分钟，所以从地球发送指令就更困难了。

paragraphs.brief: 重新评估地球上机器人的角色。
sentences: Many of the promises of artificial intelligence are still far from being fulfilled.
许多人工智能的许诺还远远没有实现。
The construction of machines simulating human logical reasoning moves towards ever more distant dates.
模拟人类逻辑推理的机器的构造正朝着更遥远的日期发展。
The more the performance of computers improves, the more we realise how difficult it is to build machines which display logical abilities.
计算机的性能越好，我们就越意识到制造出符合逻辑能力的机器是多么困难。

In the past it was confidently predicted that we would soon have fully automated factories in which all operations were performed without any human intervention, and forecasts of the complete substitution of workers by robots in many production areas were made.
过去，人们曾满怀信心地预测，我们将很快建立完全自动化的工厂，在工厂中，所有作业都是在没有任何人力干预的情况下进行的，并预测在许多生产地区，机器人完全取代工人。
Today, these perspectives are being revised.
今天，这些观点正在得到修订。
It seems that all machines, even the smartest ones, must cooperate with humans.
似乎所有机器甚至是最聪明的机器都必须与人类合作
Rather than replacing humans, the present need appears to be for an intelligent machine capable of helping a human operator without replacing him or her.
目前的需要似乎不是取代人类，而是需要一台智能机器，能够帮助操作人员，而不会取代他或她。
The word ‘cobot’, from ‘collaborative robot’, has been invented to designate this type of robot.
“协作机器人”中的“机器人”一词被发明用来指此类机器人。

paragraphs.brief: 重新审视太空中人与机器的职责。
sentences: A similar trend is also apparent in the field of space exploration.
空间探索领域也出现了类似的趋势。
Tasks which were in the past entrusted only to machines are now performed by human beings, sometimes with the aim of using simpler and less costly devices, sometimes to obtain better performance.
过去只委托给机器的任务现在由人执行，有时是为了使用更简单、更便宜的装置，有时是为了取得更好的性能。
In many cases, to involve a person in the control loop is a welcome simplification which may lower the cost of a mission without compromising safety.
在许多情况下，让一个人参与控制循环是一种值得欢迎的简化，可以在不影响安全的情况下降低特派团的费用。
Many operations originally designed to be performed under completely automatic control can be performed more efficiently by astronauts, perhaps helped by their ‘cobots’.
许多最初设计在完全自动控制下进行的操作可由宇航员更有效地进行，也许由他们的 " 机器人 " 来帮助。
The human-machine relationship must evolve towards a closer collaboration.
人与机器的关系必须朝着更密切的合作发展。

paragraphs.brief: 太空中人机合作的可能实例。
sentences: One way this could happen is by adopting the Mars Outposts approach, proposed by the Planetary Society.
这样做的一种方式是采用行星学会提议的火星外哨方法。
This would involve sending a number of robotic research stations to Mars, equipped with permanent communications and navigational systems.
这将涉及向火星派出若干机器人研究站，配备永久通信和导航系统。
They would perform research, and establish the infrastructure needed to prepare future landing sites for the exploration of Mars by humans.
它们将进行研究，建立必要的基础设施，为人类今后探索火星做好准备。
It has also been suggested that in the most difficult environments, as on Venus or Jupiter, robots could be controlled by human beings located in spaceships which remain in orbit around the planet.
还有人建议，在金星或木星等最困难的环境中，机器人可以由仍在绕地球轨道上的航天器上的人控制。
In this case, the link time for communication between humans and robots would be far less than it would be from Earth.
在这种情况下，人类和机器人之间的连接时间将远远低于地球。

paragraphs.brief: 在太空定居与加深人类的自我认识。
sentences: But if space is to be more than a place to build automatic laboratories or set up industrial enterprises in the vicinity of our planet, the presence of humans is essential.
但是，如果空间不仅仅是在我们星球附近建立自动实验室或建立工业企业的地方，人类的存在是必不可少的。
They must learn how to voyage through space towards destinations which will be not only scientific bases but also places to live.
他们必须学会如何穿越太空，前往不仅是科学基础而且也是居住地点的目的地。
If space is a frontier, that frontier must see the presence of people.
如果空间是边界，那么这一边界必须看到人民的存在。
So the aim for humankind in the future will be not just the exploration of space, but its colonisation.
因此，人类未来的目标不仅在于探索空间，而且在于其殖民化。
The result of exploring and living in space may be a deep change in the views which humankind has of itself.
探索和在空间生活的结果可能是人类自己观点的深刻变化。
And this process is already under way.
这一进程已经开始。
The images of Earth taken from the Moon in the Apollo programme have given humankind a new consciousness of its fragility, its smallness, and its unity.
阿波罗方案中从月球中拍摄的地球图像，使人类重新认识到其脆弱性、小小和团结。

These impressions have triggered a realisation of the need to protect and preserve it, for it is the place in the solar system most suitable for us and above all it is the only place we have, at least for now.
这些印象促使人们认识到需要保护和维护它，因为它是太阳系中最适合我们的地方，而且最重要的是，它是我们目前唯一的地方。

flow: 分别检视派人与派机器的限制
保障宇航员安全代价高昂，但只派机器人又会遇到突发情况和通信延迟，两种困难把问题推向重新分工。
从地面协作重新分配太空任务
地面工业从取代人转向人机协作，作者沿用这条思路，重新衡量哪些太空工作需要现场判断。
拿太空前哨方案说明分工
机器人先在火星建设设施，或在更严酷的环境中由轨道上的人近距离操控，这些方案让人机分工变得具体。
从任务效率转到亲历的意义
除了怎样完成探测，作者还关心人会获得什么，借从太空看地球的照片说明探索如何改变自我认识。

items.en: According to the writer, which TWO predictions about artificial intelligence have not yet been fulfilled?
items.zh: 据作者说，关于人工智能的两种预测尚未实现？
correct: Robots will work independently of humans.
机器人将独立于人类运作。
Robots will think in the same way as humans.
机器人会像人类一样思考

items.en: For example, when exploring the planet Mars, robots could be used to set up ________ and do initial research before humans arrive.
items.zh: 以火星探索为例，在人类抵达前，可以先派机器人建设________并开展初步研究。
items.why: 回到对应内容“它们将进行研究，建立必要的基础设施，为人类今后探索火星做好准备”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: In other cases, humans could stay in orbiting ________ and give orders to robots working on the surface of the planet.
items.zh: 另一种安排是，人类留在绕行星运行的________中，指挥在行星表面工作的机器人。
items.why: 回到对应内容“还有人建议，在金星或木星等最困难的环境中，机器人可以由仍在绕地球轨道上的航天器上的人控制”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: This would increase the speed of ________ with the robots.
items.zh: 这样就能加快与机器人之间的________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“在这种情况下，人类和机器人之间的连接时间将远远低于地球”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: In such ways, robots might be used to work in space in commercial enterprises or ________.
items.zh: 通过这类安排，机器人可以在太空中为商业企业工作，也可以在________里工作。
items.why: 回到对应内容“但是，如果空间不仅仅是在我们星球附近建立自动实验室或建立工业企业的地方，人类的存在是必不可少的”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: However, the final aim of humankind may be the ________ of space, and this could in turn change people’s attitudes towards Earth.
items.zh: 然而，人类的最终目标可能是对太空进行________，这又可能改变人们看待地球的方式。
items.why: 同词复现。注意英式拼写 colonisation (题目要求“from the passage”)。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

points: 维持宇航员生命与安全的系统体积大、费用高，开篇由此提出是否派人的问题。
回到对应内容“在这种情况下，人类和机器人之间的连接时间将远远低于地球”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: “that the idea of humans in space is popular with the public”补足 shown 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 shown 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
One human characteristic …, is the ability to perform a great variety of tasks.
“which is particularly precious in space missions, and which so far is lacking in robots”修饰前面的 characteristic。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 characteristic，再把修饰信息接回主句。
